column1: # Ground-command tokens: the digest both ends must compute from a password, a command and
# a packet number. Read by the C++ suite and by the web console's Node tests, so the two
# implementations of FNV-1a cannot drift apart without a build failing.
# The command is in the material, and that is the point of this file having a command
# column at all: without it a token authorises any command at that packet number, and a
# captured ERASE_LOG frame becomes a valid MAX_RATE frame with the key untouched.
# The last row is deliberately non-ASCII: the token is computed over UTF-8 bytes, and a
# JavaScript implementation that hashed UTF-16 code units would agree on every other row
